supersession.scope: formula implementation correction only; same parents, populations, selectors, and analysis plan

question: Characterize S06 matched observers in original feature coordinates through decision subspaces, complete four-factor margin decomposition, and training-selected coordinate contributions/interventions.

coordinate_census.centered_margin_identity: pair_margin = sum_j contribution[j] + delta_b_ab; delta_b_ab = b_a - b_b
coordinate_census.raw_affine_intercept: beta_ab = (b_a - b_b) - dot(n_ab, mu); retain separately from delta_b_ab
coordinate_census.rank_stability_split: quartet hash SHA256('FAS-S08-STABILITY-HALF-V01|' + quartet_id), low bit of first digest byte
coordinate_census.zero_sign_policy: exclude exact-zero paired contributions from sign agreement

selectors.native_magnitude_M: mean absolute contribution over S01 training rows and all three output-slot boundaries for M
selectors.native_magnitude_F: mean absolute contribution over S01 training rows and all three output-slot boundaries for F
selectors.paired_surface_difference: mean absolute paired F-minus-M contribution over S01 training rows and all three output-slot boundaries
selectors.effective_normal_disagreement: RMS M/F native pair-normal difference over all three output-slot boundaries
selectors.stable_signed_M: mean over boundaries of absolute signed-mean M contribution over S01 training rows
selectors.stable_signed_F: mean over boundaries of absolute signed-mean F contribution over S01 training rows

matched_control.standardization: mean and population standard deviation across 2048 coordinates, training data only; zero std maps to one
matched_control.algorithm: greedy nearest unused unselected coordinate, selected coordinates visited by descending selector score then ascending ID; distance ties by ascending coordinate ID

intervention.operation: set chosen coordinates in native-standardized representation to zero
